NEWSANGUO_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_HEAVENS_FOR: At the end of your turn, if you have a great deal of [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold], you may accept [gold]Heaven[/gold]'s aid. Otherwise, you suffer [gold]Heaven's Decay[/gold].

At the end of your turn, if your points are at least [blue]10[/blue], you may spend 10 [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold] to gain 1 [gold]extra turn[/gold] that deals double damage. If your points are at most [blue]-10[/blue], you suffer [gold]Heaven's Decay[/gold] and restore 10 [gold]Heaven's Force[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_KEYWORD_RECRUIT.title: Recruit {Summon}
NEWSANGUO_KEYWORD_RECRUIT.description:
Generate {Summon} Qingzhou Soldiers with 1 HP each. When you are attacked, Qingzhou Soldiers take damage before your [gold]Block[/gold] is consumed.
At the end of the enemy turn, lose all recruited Qingzhou Soldiers.
You can have at most 15 Qingzhou Soldiers.
NEWSANGUO_SUNQIAN_VIGOR_INTEROP.gainHove: For characters from the [purple]Sunqian Universe mod[/purple], this effect triggers when gaining [gold]Vigor[/gold] instead of [gold]Drunken Might[/gold].
NEWSANGUO_SUNQIAN_VIGOR_INTEROP.loseHove: For characters from the [purple]Sunqian Universe mod[/purple], this effect triggers when losing [gold]Vigor[/gold] instead of [gold]Drunken Might[/gold].
